description: Run the GPU part of a $vlm-ocr pipeline on Leiden University's ALICE cluster: decide whether a corpus needs ALICE, pick a GPU partition for the model, set up storage, a pinned vLLM environment and offline weights, ship code and scans, run a gate job and chained bulk jobs with the bundled SLURM template, and bring the page records home for post-processing. Use with $vlm-ocr when OCRing scans on ALICE or deciding whether to.
